tv: TCL 65C7K (Smart TV Pro, G08, G08_4K_GB, MediaTek mt5896), Brazil and Australia
notes: Same build as the C755 list (UTT2.250416.001); Samba TV ACR, TCL Live, promos, store/hotel demo, Alexa, partner auto-installs; Assistant, USB media, Claro TV+, Mercado Play off by choice; Chromecast, AirPlay, game bar, soundbar updater and dreamx kept; keep `tv.mopa.ginga` for TV aberta; Wireless debugging needs Wi-Fi (pair, then `adb tcpip 5555`); setupwraith owned the Wi-Fi network on the Brazil unit, re-join before disabling it. An Australian 65C7K on the same build also had AirPlay, Miracast, T-Cast, game bar, Stan and YouTube Music off (commented out in the list); its remote's app buttons and gear need a key helper, which costs the held-volume ramp. A second unit in this folder, `debloat-75t8c-eu.txt`, is a 75T8C on the same firmware in Sweden (Android TV 14, sv-SE): there ttvs, interactive, channelplus, waterfall and suspension must stay enabled, each with its failure signature
